locationHits: Tieisha Thomas is a NYC native hailing from Queens, NY.  She discovered her love of music at a young age through the influences of her vibrant Caribbean culture. She attended LaGuardia Highschool of the Arts for Voice and received her Bachelors Degree in Theater from Buffalo State. She was most recently seen Off- Broadway in Disneys “HERCULES” as one of the greek chorus muses. When she’s not performing, she enjoys creatively developing her own original content, teaching, dancing and devouring crab legs!
